summary.goal: Implement the Express plugin mount for the plannr server. Follows the existing pattern: export createMullService(config) factory function that returns { router, initialize(), shutdown(), getStorage() }. Server mounts router at /api/mull. Provides REST endpoints for triggering mull runs programmatically, checking memory status, and reading topic files via API. This enables other services (forge, planner-lead, UI) to trigger memory extraction and query memory state without CLI.

acceptance_criteria.description: createMullService(config) exports factory following the ServiceConfig/Service pattern: returns { router: Router, initialize(): Promise<void>, shutdown(): Promise<void>, getStorage() }
POST /api/mull/run accepts SessionRef discriminant: { type: 'planner-trajectory', planId } | { type: 'forge-run', runId } | { type: 'relay-session', sessionId } and routes to the correct adapter(s)
POST /api/mull/run returns MergeResult: { topicsUpdated, topicsCreated, nuggetsWritten }
POST /api/mull/run/all triggers mullAll for all unprocessed sessions across all configured adapters
GET /api/mull/status returns { topicCount, lastUpdated, recentSessions[], memoryDir, adapterStatus[] }
GET /api/mull/topics returns list of topic summaries from index.md frontmatter
GET /api/mull/topics/:slug returns full topic file content (parsed frontmatter + body)
Server initialization: createMullService configures adapters from server environment (DB paths from ServiceConfig, relay dir)
Error handling uses @plannr/errors (NotFoundError for missing topics, BadRequestError for invalid SessionRef)
Input validation uses Zod schemas for POST /run body and query params
Non-blocking: POST /run executes asynchronously, returns immediately with { jobId, status: 'accepted' } for long sessions
SessionRef routing: POST /run dispatches to correct adapter based on discriminant type field, returns BadRequestError for unknown types

observations: Follows exact same pattern as planner, ideation, forge router factories — but uses the Service interface pattern (router + initialize + shutdown + getStorage)
Server knows the DB paths (planner.db, forge.db, .agent-relay/) — passes them to createMullService in ServiceConfig
POST /run is the main action endpoint — SessionRef discriminant type determines which adapter handles the request
GET /topics endpoints enable UI or agents to query memory without filesystem access
Non-blocking is important: a full mull run with LLM call takes a few seconds — don't block the HTTP response
Could use SSE to stream mull progress (like usePlanEvents pattern) if UI needs real-time feedback

steps.title: Define MullServiceConfig interface and Zod schemas

acceptance_criteria.description: MullServiceConfig follows the codebase ServiceConfig pattern
RunRequestSchema is a Zod discriminated union on 'type' field with three variants
All request/response types exported for consumer use
MullService interface defines router, initialize, shutdown, getAdapterStatus

steps.specification: Location: packages/mull/src/server/types.ts. Zod discriminatedUnion requires the discriminant field in each variant. Use z.intersection() to add shared fields (force, dryRun) to the discriminated union. Export inferred types: type RunRequest = z.infer<typeof RunRequestSchema>. MullService follows the same pattern as createForgeService/createIdeationService in the server codebase.

steps.title: Implement createMullService factory function
steps.description:
Create packages/mull/src/server/mull-service.ts. Implement createMullService(config: MullServiceConfig): MullService following the exact codebase pattern.

initialize(): Instantiate the three adapters (PlannerDbAdapter, ForgeDbAdapter, RelayDaemonAdapter) using paths from config. Create the MullPipeline instance with the adapters. Ensure memoryDir exists (mkdir -p equivalent).

shutdown(): Close all adapter DB connections. Clear any pending async jobs.

getAdapterStatus(): Return status of each adapter (connected/error, last cursor timestamp, config summary).

The router is created during construction but adapters are initialized in initialize() — this matches the server startup sequence where services are created first, then initialized.

acceptance_criteria.description: createMullService returns object with router, initialize, shutdown, getAdapterStatus
initialize() creates all three adapters from config paths
shutdown() closes all adapter connections and clears pending jobs
Router created during construction, adapters initialized in initialize()

steps.specification: Location: packages/mull/src/server/mull-service.ts. Export createMullService(config: MullServiceConfig): MullService. Construction: create Express Router, attach route handlers. initialize(): create PlannerDbAdapter({ dbPath: config.plannerDbPath }), ForgeDbAdapter({ dbPath: config.forgeDbPath }), RelayDaemonAdapter({ dataDir: config.relayDataDir, mode: config.relayMode || 'jsonl' }). Job tracking: const jobs = new Map<string, { status, result?, error? }>(). Use crypto.randomUUID() for jobIds.

steps.title: Implement POST /run with SessionRef routing
steps.description:
Implement the POST /run route handler. Validates request body with RunRequestSchema (Zod). Routes based on the discriminant 'type' field:

- type='planner-trajectory': Extract planId, call pipeline.run() with the PlannerDbAdapter for that planId
- type='forge-run': Extract runId, call pipeline.run() with the ForgeDbAdapter for that runId
- type='relay-session': Extract sessionId, call pipeline.run() with the RelayDaemonAdapter for that sessionId
- Unknown type: Return badRequest('Unknown session type: {type}') from @plannr/errors

Execution is async: Immediately return { jobId: uuid, status: 'accepted' } with HTTP 202. The pipeline.run() executes in the background. Store job state in a Map<jobId, { status, result?, error? }> for later retrieval.

If force=true, ignore cursor and reprocess all events. If dryRun=true, run extraction but don't write to topic files.

acceptance_criteria.description: Request validated with Zod RunRequestSchema
Routes to correct adapter based on discriminant type field
Returns HTTP 202 with jobId immediately, runs pipeline in background
Unknown type returns BadRequestError from @plannr/errors
force flag bypasses cursor, dryRun flag prevents writes
Job state tracked in Map for later status retrieval

steps.specification: The SessionRef discriminant routing is the key design decision here. Instead of accepting a generic sessionId and guessing which adapter to use, the caller explicitly declares the session type. This makes the API self-documenting and eliminates ambiguity when session IDs from different sources might collide.

steps.title: Implement POST /run/all, GET /status, GET /jobs/:jobId
steps.description:
Implement three additional route handlers:

1) POST /run/all: Call pipeline.runAll() which iterates all configured adapters, calls listSessions() filtered by cursor, and runs the pipeline for each unprocessed session. Returns { jobId, status: 'accepted', sessionsQueued: number }. Async execution like POST /run.

2) GET /status: Synchronous. Returns { topicCount (count .md files in memoryDir), lastUpdated (most recent topic file mtime), recentSessions[] (last 10 processed from cursor files), memoryDir (path), adapterStatus[] (from getAdapterStatus()) }.

3) GET /jobs/:jobId: Returns the current state of an async job: { jobId, status: 'accepted' | 'running' | 'completed' | 'failed', result?: MergeResult, error?: string }. Returns notFound() if jobId unknown.

acceptance_criteria.description: POST /run/all processes all unprocessed sessions across all adapters
GET /status returns topic count, last updated, adapter status
GET /jobs/:jobId returns job state, notFound for unknown jobId
All async endpoints return HTTP 202 with jobId

steps.title: Implement GET /topics and GET /topics/:slug
steps.description:
Implement topic reading endpoints:

1) GET /topics: Read memoryDir, list all .md files. For each file, parse YAML frontmatter to extract: slug, title, nugget_count, last_updated, tags. Return array of topic summaries sorted by last_updated descending.

2) GET /topics/:slug: Find the topic file by slug (slug.md or directory matching). Parse full content: YAML frontmatter + markdown body. Return { slug, title, frontmatter, body, nuggets[] }. If topic not found, return notFound('Topic not found: {slug}') from @plannr/errors.

Use a simple YAML frontmatter parser (gray-matter or manual --- delimiter split).

acceptance_criteria.description: GET /topics returns list of topic summaries from frontmatter
GET /topics/:slug returns full topic content with parsed frontmatter and body
Missing topic returns NotFoundError from @plannr/errors
Topics sorted by last_updated descending

steps.title: Mount mull service in server initialization
steps.description:
In packages/server/src/server.ts (or wherever services are mounted), add the mull service to the server initialization sequence:

1) Import createMullService from '@plannr/mull'
2) Create MullServiceConfig from environment: { plannerDbPath: process.env.DB_PATH || './planner.db', forgeDbPath: process.env.FORGE_DB_PATH || './forge.db', relayDataDir: '.agent-relay', memoryDir: '.mull/memory' }
3) const mullService = createMullService(config)
4) await mullService.initialize() during server startup
5) app.use('/api/mull', mullService.router)
6) Add mullService.shutdown() to graceful shutdown handlers

This follows the exact same pattern as planner, ideation, and forge service mounting. Mount AFTER relay detection so relayMode can be determined.

acceptance_criteria.description: createMullService imported and initialized in server startup
Router mounted at /api/mull
Config derived from environment variables (DB_PATH, FORGE_DB_PATH)
shutdown() called during graceful server shutdown
Mounted after relay detection in startup sequence

steps.specification: Location: packages/server/src/server.ts. Follow the exact pattern of existing service mounts (planner, ideation, forge). Import createMullService from '@plannr/mull'. Mount order in server.ts: after forge initialization (so FORGE_DB_PATH is resolved) and after relay detection (so relayMode can be set). Add to the services[] array for graceful shutdown. Config derivation: plannerDbPath from process.env.DB_PATH || './planner.db', forgeDbPath from process.env.FORGE_DB_PATH || './forge.db'.

steps.title: Write tests for API routes and SessionRef routing
steps.description:
Create packages/mull/src/server/__tests__/mull-service.test.ts. Use supertest to test Express routes. Mock the adapters and pipeline. Test:
- POST /run with each SessionRef type routes to correct adapter
- POST /run with unknown type returns 400
- POST /run returns 202 with jobId
- GET /jobs/:jobId returns job state
- GET /jobs/:unknown returns 404
- POST /run/all triggers all adapters
- GET /status returns adapter status
- GET /topics returns topic list
- GET /topics/:slug returns topic content
- GET /topics/:missing returns 404
- Zod validation rejects malformed POST bodies
- force and dryRun flags propagated to pipeline

Use Vitest.

acceptance_criteria.description: Tests cover all three SessionRef routing paths
Tests verify error handling (400 for bad input, 404 for missing resources)
Tests verify async execution returns 202
Tests verify Zod validation rejects malformed bodies
All tests pass with Vitest
